name: Orion The Ultimate Choco Chip Cookies
ingredients_raw: REFINED WHEAT FLOUR (MAIDA), CHOCOLATE CHIPS (26%) {SUGAR, (COCOA SOLIDS & COCOA BUTTER) (46.5%), EMULSIFIERS (INS 322, INS 476), NATURAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCE (VANILLA)}. HYDROGENATED VEGETABLE FAT, LIQUID GLUCOSE, SUGAR, MILK SOLIDS, INVERT SYRUP, COCOA SOLIDS, LEAVENING AGENTS [INS 503(ii), INS 500(ii)], EDIBLE COMMON SALT, EMULSIFIER (INS 322). NATURE IDENTICAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES (CHOCOLATE, MILK & VANILLA), ALLERGEN INFORMATION: CONTAINS WHEAT, MILK AND SOY. MAY CONTAIN SULPHITE & NUTS.
